measures.title: Jefferson County proposed tax levy (renewal) – developmental disabilities
measures.summary: Renews a Jefferson County tax for community programs and services authorized by the county Board of Developmental Disabilities and for acquiring, building, renovating, financing, maintaining and operating developmental disabilities facilities. The county auditor estimates it will collect $2,141,041 a year at up to 1.7 mills, or $19 for each $100,000 of market value, for 10 years starting in 2027, first due in 2028.
measures.yesMeans: The developmental disabilities levy would continue for 10 more years.
measures.noMeans: The developmental disabilities levy would not be renewed.

measures.title: Jefferson County proposed tax levy (renewal) – 9-1-1 system
measures.summary: Renews a Jefferson County tax to fund the operation of the county 9-1-1 system. The county auditor estimates it will collect $2,482,785 a year at up to 1.5 mills, or $35 for each $100,000 of market value, for 5 years starting in 2027, first due in 2028.
measures.yesMeans: The 9-1-1 system levy would continue for 5 more years.
measures.noMeans: The 9-1-1 system levy would not be renewed.
